title.narrative: Municipal Sanitation and Drainage Systems Activity

description.narrative: Mozambique - Water Supply And Sanitation Project - Municipal Sanitation and Drainage Systems Activity: As a means of complementing the enhanced water supply, the Water Supply and Sanitation Project will improve sanitation systems by investigating feasible opportunities to expand wastewater treatment, improve the piped sewage network, and increase the usage of septic systems in the urban centers and latrines in the peri-urban areas. In addition, storm drains will be rehabilitated or added to improve drainage efficiency which protects urban land usage.
